title: Adapt bounded claim-specific evidence and assessments into Matter
summary: Reuse IO2-142 and the existing cognition/evaluator clients to prepare bounded per-proposition Matter assessments. Bind every question and result to the actual admitted evidence, source versions, scope, coverage, sharing policy and evaluator identity; cache unchanged valid work and leave optional research detached.
in_scope: Packet hashes, citation ownership, read dependencies, coverage and availability cuts
Existing evaluator/provider client reuse and deterministic recorded-result mode
Targeted semantic cache invalidation and bounded optional investigation handoff
out_of_scope: A new repository evidence graph or unrestricted model browsing
Automatic trust promotion or model-written scope/intent
Assuming unavailable evidence is a negative finding
Real provider evaluation or production integration in this scaffold
Making model availability mandatory for deterministic matter maintenance
implementation: Define the Oil assessment adapter over MAT-027/028 question and packet contracts. Each request names one proposition or explicit comparison, claim kind, applicable rule/profile, source and audience/purpose versions, availability cut, completeness/omissions and admitted content digest.

Translate IO2-142 domain preparation and NarrowState/JudgmentEvidenceSource results without expanding the final admitted scope. Reuse named ticket paths, repository profiles and existing EXAIS/cognition clients; preserve pathless/refused-owner conservative behavior and provider sharing restrictions.

Map actual final request/citation bytes into evidence receipts, including source snapshot identity, excerpt ranges, per-claim ownership and absence coverage. Register content dependencies and complete-scope absence watches in the operational namespace so later relevant evidence invalidates the result.

Invoke the existing evaluator clients through the Matter question/provider seam with pinned contract/model settings and bounded batches. Validate that results bind the exact packet, claim and admitted citations; return named unavailable/contract-mismatch/unknown states instead of retrying unboundedly.

Cache results by semantic packet and evaluator/rule identity. Reuse unchanged valid judgments across renderings and timer ticks; source, coverage, rule or relevant purpose changes invalidate only affected work. Do not mix actor intent, prior generated advice or unrelated working beliefs into a narrow evidence question.

Provide an optional bounded investigation request through the existing coordinator/session seam when a named missing fact could alter a decision. Bind allowed paths/scope, read/call/byte/deadline budgets and stopping conditions; persistence and deterministic lifecycle must succeed with this facility disabled.

acceptance.criterion: Each assessment is bound to the exact admitted claim-specific payload and cannot cite refused, future or unadmitted evidence.
acceptance.verification: Use citation-present, citation-missing, code-contradiction, pathless-owner, refused-owner and future-available fixtures; independently mutate final payload/citation ownership and verify named refusal or incomplete outcome.

acceptance.criterion: Unchanged semantic packets reuse valid judgments, while changed relevant source or absence coverage invalidates dependent assessments and pending attention.
acceptance.verification: Replay identical packets under timer/render/session changes, then modify a cited file and add previously absent in-scope evidence; assert unchanged cases make zero extra evaluator calls and changed cases invalidate the appropriate dependency chain.

acceptance.criterion: Every evaluator/investigation path stays within declared sharing, byte, call and elapsed-time budgets and fails without blocking ordinary host work.
acceptance.verification: Run deterministic fake-provider oversize/refusal/timeout/cancellation scenarios and local-only evidence cases; inspect request receipts, budget accounting and hook latency without requiring a paid provider.

acceptance.criterion: The adapter works in a provider-disabled profile and does not convert interpretation into accepted authority.
acceptance.verification: Run deterministic failure/recovery episodes with all provider clients unavailable; assert lifecycle and quiet/eligible decisions still operate, semantic status remains explicit unknown, and ledger authority/projection is unchanged.

tests: Documentation rule with relevant docs versus unrelated code-only evidence
Citation present/missing, code contradiction, refused/pathless owner and unavailable graph coverage
Batch contains multiple claims with independent admitted citation ownership
Known absent source becomes available after assessment
Provider tries unapproved evidence or claims a citation outside the final packet
Timer/render replay reuses unchanged assessment; source/rule change recomputes only affected work
Provider-disabled deterministic capture/recovery and bounded investigation timeout
risks: Reusing a prepared context before its final filtering/byte cut can falsely advertise evidence that the evaluator never saw.
Missing coverage dependencies allow an apparently negative judgment to remain current after relevant evidence arrives.
Wrapping providers twice can duplicate cost, receipt ownership and retries unless the existing client remains the invocation owner.
Model confidence and diagnostic margins are not calibrated authority or a universal matter priority.

reuse.application: Reuse bounded domain preparation, honest absence/coverage, final-payload and native caller controls; retain its open real-provider acceptance cases.
Use NarrowState/JudgmentEvidenceSource and bounded context admission rather than constructing a second evidence graph.
Reuse existing evaluator invocation/result contracts and attach explicit operational dependency receipts.
Reuse the opt-in bounded local research seam with replay restrictions and no changes to native hook authority.

sources: User's active Matter build request, 2026-10-08: repurpose durable matters to absorb annoying live agent-session input until a material development warrants attention; complete the scaffold/specification/roadmap, without implementing downstream integrations.
Original repository inputs: matterbrainstormspec; matterjevmesh; jevinmatter (design notes, not implementation evidence).
